obfuscation_indicators: factors underlying our forecasts are dynamic
risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively precise and strongly quantified, detailing store growth, comparable-store sales, margins, expenses, taxes, and earnings per share. Tone is confident and favorable, supported by improving operating metrics, though it acknowledges macroeconomic, competitive, execution, and forecasting uncertainties. Standard forward-looking disclaimers and limited detail in the truncated liquidity section modestly reduce transparency.
